example_en: Our customer asked for a revised schedule.
example_zh: 我們的客戶要求修改時程。

zh: 客戶（多指長期或專業服務）
example_en: We are meeting a new client in Osaka next week.
example_zh: 我們下週要在大阪和一位新客戶見面。
note: client 多用於顧問、代理等長期合作；customer 泛指購買產品或服務的人

example_en: The end user will never see this setting.
example_zh: 終端使用者永遠不會看到這個設定。

example_en: This operator is one of our key accounts in Taiwan.
example_zh: 這家業者是我們在台灣的重點客戶之一。

example_en: Your account manager will contact you tomorrow.
example_zh: 您的客戶經理明天會與您聯絡。

example_en: We have ten prospects in the pipeline this quarter.
example_zh: 這一季我們手上有十個潛在客戶在洽談。

example_en: The trade show brought us many new leads.
example_zh: 這次展覽為我們帶來許多新的銷售線索。

example_en: Existing customers get a special price on upgrades.
example_zh: 既有客戶升級可享特別價格。

example_en: She has been a loyal customer for ten years.
example_zh: 她當我們的忠實客戶已經十年了。

example_en: Corporate customers have a dedicated support line.
example_zh: 企業客戶有專屬的客服專線。

example_en: We want to expand our customer base in Southeast Asia.
example_zh: 我們希望擴大在東南亞的客戶群。

example_en: Please make sure the decision maker joins the call.
example_zh: 請確認決策者會參加這通電話會議。

example_en: Who is the contact person for this order?
example_zh: 這張訂單的聯絡人是哪一位？

example_en: Ms. Ito acts as our liaison with the Tokyo office.
example_zh: 伊藤小姐是我們和東京辦公室之間的聯絡窗口。

example_en: We truly value our long-term business relationship.
example_zh: 我們非常重視雙方長期的合作關係。

example_en: Small talk helps build rapport with new clients.
example_zh: 閒聊有助於和新客戶建立融洽關係。

example_en: It takes time to earn the customer's trust.
example_zh: 贏得客戶的信任需要時間。

zh: 善意補償；表達誠意的舉動
example_en: We offered one free month as a goodwill gesture.
example_zh: 我們提供一個月免費，作為表達誠意的補償。

example_en: Our goal is to become a truly customer-centric company.
example_zh: 我們的目標是成為真正以客戶為中心的公司。

example_en: We mapped the entire customer journey, from sign-up to support.
example_zh: 我們把從申辦到客服的整個客戶旅程都整理出來。

zh: 接觸點（客戶與公司互動的每個環節）
example_en: Every touchpoint shapes the customer's impression of us.
example_zh: 每一個接觸點都會影響客戶對我們的印象。

example_en: A faster app will improve the customer experience.
example_zh: 更快的 App 會改善客戶體驗。

example_en: Customer retention is cheaper than finding new customers.
example_zh: 留住客戶比開發新客戶更省成本。

example_en: Good after-sales service builds customer loyalty.
example_zh: 良好的售後服務能培養客戶忠誠度。

example_en: Most of our new clients come through word of mouth.
example_zh: 我們大多數的新客戶都是靠口碑來的。

example_en: We got this contract through a referral from a partner.
example_zh: 這份合約是透過合作夥伴推薦拿到的。

example_en: Repeat customers account for half of our sales.
example_zh: 回頭客占了我們一半的營業額。

zh: 臨櫃客戶；未預約直接上門的客人
example_en: The store is busy with walk-in customers on weekends.
example_zh: 門市週末有很多臨櫃客戶。

example_en: VIP customers are served by a senior representative.
example_zh: 貴賓客戶由資深專員負責服務。

example_en: We call high-value customers before their contracts expire.
example_zh: 我們會在高價值客戶合約到期前主動致電。

example_en: We offered a discount to win back former users.
example_zh: 我們提供折扣來挽回以前的用戶。

example_en: Our customer acquisition cost rose this year.
example_zh: 我們今年的獲客成本上升了。

example_en: Bundled plans increase customer lifetime value.
example_zh: 組合方案能提高客戶終身價值。
note: 常縮寫為 CLV 或 LTV

example_en: Please check the customer profile before the visit.
example_zh: 拜訪前請先看一下客戶資料。

example_en: Students are a fast-growing customer segment for us.
example_zh: 學生是我們成長快速的客群。

example_en: We designed the service around three user personas.
example_zh: 我們依照三種用戶人物誌來設計這項服務。

example_en: Please log every customer call in the CRM.
example_zh: 每通客戶電話都請記錄在 CRM 裡。

example_en: The survey gave us valuable customer insights.
example_zh: 這份調查給了我們很有價值的客戶洞察。

example_en: We review the voice of the customer every month.
example_zh: 我們每個月都會檢視客戶心聲。

example_en: Thank you for calling. How may I help you?
example_zh: 感謝您的來電，請問有什麼可以為您服務的？

example_en: May I ask who's calling? I'll put you through.
example_zh: 請問您是哪位？我幫您轉接。

example_en: Could you hold on a moment, please?
example_zh: 可以請您稍等一下嗎？

example_en: Sorry, I need to put you on hold briefly.
example_zh: 抱歉，需要請您在線上稍候片刻。

example_en: I'll transfer your call to the billing team.
example_zh: 我幫您把電話轉接到帳務組。

example_en: Sorry to keep you waiting. I have your answer now.
example_zh: 抱歉讓您久等了，我查到答案了。

example_en: I'll call you back within an hour.
example_zh: 我一小時內回電給您。

example_en: I'm returning your call from this morning.
example_zh: 我是回覆您今天早上的來電。

example_en: He's in a meeting. Would you like to leave a message?
example_zh: 他正在開會，您要留言嗎？

example_en: Is this Ms. Lin? — Yes, speaking.
example_zh: 「請問是林小姐嗎？」「是，我就是。」

example_en: Sorry, the line is breaking up. Could you repeat that?
example_zh: 抱歉，收訊斷斷續續的，可以再說一次嗎？

en: Could you speak a little slower?
example_en: Could you speak a little slower? I'm taking notes.
example_zh: 可以請您說慢一點嗎？我正在做筆記。

en: Could you spell that for me?
example_en: Could you spell that for me? I want to get it right.
example_zh: 可以幫我拼一下嗎？我想確認沒寫錯。

example_en: Let me repeat that: order number 4512, correct?
example_zh: 我複述一下：訂單編號 4512，對嗎？

en: Is now a good time to talk?
ipa: /ɪz ˈnaʊ ə ɡʊd ˈtaɪm tə ˈtɔːk/
example_en: Hi, Mr. Sato. Is now a good time to talk?
example_zh: 佐藤先生您好，現在方便說話嗎？

example_en: I'm calling about the invoice you sent last week.
example_zh: 我打來是想詢問您上週寄來的發票。

example_en: Our support team is available during business hours.
example_zh: 我們的客服團隊在營業時間內提供服務。

example_en: Please call our 24-hour hotline for urgent issues.
example_zh: 緊急問題請撥打我們的 24 小時服務專線。

example_en: Please bring your ID to the service counter.
example_zh: 請攜帶身分證件到服務櫃台。

example_en: Here is my direct line if you need anything.
example_zh: 有任何需要可以打我的直撥電話。

en: It was nice talking to you.
example_en: It was nice talking to you. I'll send the details today.
example_zh: 很高興和您通話，我今天會把細節寄給您。

example_en: We had some small talk about the weather first.
example_zh: 我們先聊了一下天氣當作寒暄。

en: Is there anything else I can help you with?
zh: 還有其他需要協助的地方嗎？
ipa: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈɛls aɪ kæn ˈhɛlp ju wɪð/
example_en: Your plan is updated. Is there anything else I can help you with?
example_zh: 您的方案已更新，還有其他需要協助的地方嗎？

example_en: Inbound calls double on the first day of each month.
example_zh: 每個月第一天的進線電話會多一倍。

example_en: The client has a special request about the delivery time.
example_zh: 客戶對交貨時間有特殊需求。

example_en: We collected the customer requirements in the first meeting.
example_zh: 我們在第一次會議中蒐集了客戶需求。

example_en: We'll do a needs assessment before proposing a solution.
example_zh: 提出方案之前，我們會先做需求評估。

example_en: What is the customer's biggest pain point right now?
example_zh: 客戶目前最大的痛點是什麼？

example_en: Your installation appointment is Tuesday morning.
example_zh: 您的安裝預約在週二上午。

example_en: I checked the call log, and you called us twice.
example_zh: 我查了通話紀錄，您打來過兩次。

example_en: Let me look into this and call you back.
example_zh: 我了解一下狀況再回電給您。

example_en: Could you provide more details about the error message?
example_zh: 能否提供更多關於錯誤訊息的細節？

example_en: I'll leave a brochure with you after the meeting.
example_zh: 會後我會留一份簡介手冊給您。

example_en: Our latest product catalog is on the website.
example_zh: 我們最新的產品型錄放在官網上。

example_en: Can we schedule a demo for your team next week?
example_zh: 下週可以為貴團隊安排一場產品展示嗎？

example_en: You can start with a 30-day free trial.
example_zh: 您可以先從 30 天免費試用開始。

example_en: The customer requested a quote for 200 routers.
example_zh: 客戶索取了 200 台路由器的報價。

example_en: Most answers can be found in our FAQ.
example_zh: 大部分的答案都可以在常見問題中找到。

example_en: We received three complaints about slow delivery.
example_zh: 我們收到三件關於出貨太慢的客訴。

example_en: The customer filed a complaint with the regulator.
example_zh: 這位客戶向主管機關提出了正式申訴。

example_en: Dissatisfied customers rarely tell you; they just leave.
example_zh: 不滿意的客戶很少直接說，他們只會默默離開。

example_en: I understand you're frustrated with the delay.
example_zh: 我理解這次延誤讓您很困擾。

example_en: An irate caller demanded to speak to a manager.
example_zh: 一位憤怒的來電者要求和主管通話。

example_en: Please put your grievance in writing.
example_zh: 請將您的申訴事項以書面提出。

example_en: If it's not solved today, I'll escalate it to my manager.
example_zh: 如果今天沒解決，我會往上呈報給主管。

example_en: New staff receive training in complaint handling.
example_zh: 新進人員會接受客訴處理的訓練。

example_en: This is a recurring issue, so we need a permanent fix.
example_zh: 這是反覆發生的問題，所以需要徹底解決。

example_en: We let you down this time, and we're truly sorry.
example_zh: 這次我們讓您失望了，真的非常抱歉。

example_en: The new service fell short of the client's expectations.
example_zh: 新服務沒有達到客戶的預期。

example_en: We will replace any defective units free of charge.
example_zh: 任何不良品我們都會免費更換。

example_en: The customer returned a faulty charger.
example_zh: 客戶退回了一個故障的充電器。

example_en: Two boxes were damaged in transit.
example_zh: 有兩箱貨在運送途中損壞了。

example_en: The client received the wrong item and wants an exchange.
example_zh: 客戶收到送錯的商品，想要換貨。

example_en: Please tell us which missing parts you need.
example_zh: 請告訴我們缺少哪些零件。

example_en: I think I was overcharged on my last bill.
example_zh: 我覺得我上一期帳單被多收錢了。

example_en: We have corrected the billing error on your account.
example_zh: 我們已經更正您帳戶上的帳單錯誤。

example_en: Many customers left because of poor service.
example_zh: 很多客戶因為服務不佳而流失。

example_en: Please reply to every negative review within a day.
example_zh: 每則負評都請在一天內回覆。

example_en: Let the customer vent before offering a solution.
example_zh: 先讓客戶把情緒發洩完，再提出解決方法。

example_en: Please accept our sincere apology for the outage.
example_zh: 對於這次服務中斷，請接受我們誠摯的歉意。

zh: 聽到這件事我很遺憾／很抱歉。
example_en: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me see what I can do.
example_zh: 聽到這件事我很抱歉，我看看能怎麼幫您。

example_en: I completely understand. A week is too long to wait.
example_zh: 我完全理解，等一個星期真的太久了。

example_en: Showing empathy calms most upset customers.
example_zh: 展現同理心能讓多數不高興的客戶冷靜下來。

zh: 承認；表示理解（對方的感受）
example_en: First, acknowledge the customer's feelings.
example_zh: 首先，要先表示理解客戶的感受。

example_en: We take full responsibility for the mistake.
example_zh: 我們對這個錯誤負起全部責任。

example_en: We aim to resolve all cases within 48 hours.
example_zh: 我們的目標是在 48 小時內解決所有案件。

example_en: Are you satisfied with the resolution we offered?
example_zh: 您對我們提出的處理方式滿意嗎？

example_en: We'll provide an interim solution until the new part arrives.
example_zh: 新零件到貨前，我們會先提供過渡方案。

example_en: Please send us your corrective action plan by Monday.
example_zh: 請在週一前提供矯正措施計畫。

example_en: We can offer a partial refund for the missed days.
example_zh: 沒用到的那幾天，我們可以退還部分費用。

example_en: Your refund will appear on your card within seven days.
example_zh: 退款會在七天內退回您的信用卡。

example_en: We'll ship a replacement unit tomorrow.
example_zh: 我們明天會寄出替換的機器。

example_en: You can request an exchange within 14 days.
example_zh: 您可以在 14 天內申請換貨。

example_en: Please read our return policy before you buy.
example_zh: 購買前請先閱讀我們的退貨政策。

example_en: We can offer store credit instead of a cash refund.
example_zh: 我們可以用購物金取代現金退款。

example_en: We'll add a complimentary data pack to your plan.
example_zh: 我們會在您的方案中免費加贈一個上網流量包。

example_en: Installation is free of charge for new customers.
example_zh: 新客戶安裝免費。

zh: 彌補過失；把事情處理好
example_en: We'll do whatever it takes to make it right.
example_zh: 我們會盡一切努力把事情處理好。

example_en: We've changed our process, so this won't happen again.
example_zh: 我們已經調整流程，這種事不會再發生。

example_en: We have taken preventive measures to avoid future delays.
example_zh: 我們已採取預防措施，避免日後再延誤。

en: Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
zh: 感謝您告知我們這件事。
ipa: /ˈθæŋk ju fər ˈbrɪŋɪŋ ðɪs tu ˈaʊr əˈtɛnʃən/
example_en: Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We'll fix it today.
example_zh: 感謝您告知我們這件事，我們今天就會修正。

example_en: Please contact customer service if you need help.
example_zh: 如果需要協助，請聯絡客服。

example_en: Our customer care team will call you tomorrow.
example_zh: 我們的客服團隊明天會致電給您。

example_en: A customer service representative will be with you shortly.
example_zh: 客服專員很快就會為您服務。
note: 常縮寫為 CSR 或 rep

zh: 客服中心；電話服務中心
example_en: Our call center handles 5,000 calls a day.
example_zh: 我們的客服中心一天處理五千通電話。

example_en: You can check your case status online.
example_zh: 您可以上網查詢案件處理進度。

example_en: Please keep your case number for future reference.
example_zh: 請保留您的案件編號以便日後查詢。

example_en: First-line support handles simple password issues.
example_zh: 第一線支援負責處理簡單的密碼問題。

zh: 服務補救（出錯後挽回客戶信任）
example_en: Good service recovery can turn a complaint into loyalty.
example_zh: 做好服務補救，能把客訴轉成忠誠度。

example_en: The usual turnaround time for repairs is five days.
example_zh: 維修通常需要五天的處理時間。

example_en: You are number three in the queue.
example_zh: 您目前排在第三位。

example_en: The current wait time is about ten minutes.
example_zh: 目前的等候時間大約十分鐘。

example_en: You can submit a callback request instead of waiting.
example_zh: 您可以申請回電，不必在線上等候。

example_en: Live chat is the fastest way to reach us.
example_zh: 線上即時客服是聯絡我們最快的方式。

example_en: The chatbot answers basic questions about billing.
example_zh: 聊天機器人會回答帳單的基本問題。

example_en: Customers can change plans on the self-service portal.
example_zh: 客戶可以在自助服務平台上更改方案。

example_en: I added this solution to the knowledge base.
example_zh: 我把這個解法加進知識庫了。

example_en: I'll email you step-by-step instructions for the setup.
example_zh: 我會把設定的逐步操作說明寄給您。

example_en: We can arrange an on-site visit on Thursday.
example_zh: 我們可以安排週四到府服務。

example_en: Our after-sales service covers on-site repairs.
example_zh: 我們的售後服務包含到府維修。

example_en: Customer satisfaction rose by five points this year.
example_zh: 今年客戶滿意度提升了五個百分點。

example_en: Please take a minute to complete our satisfaction survey.
example_zh: 請花一分鐘填寫我們的滿意度調查。

example_en: Our Net Promoter Score improved after the app update.
example_zh: App 更新後，我們的淨推薦值提高了。
note: 常縮寫為 NPS，衡量客戶願意推薦的程度

example_en: Thank you for your feedback on the new plan.
example_zh: 感謝您對新方案的意見回饋。

example_en: Could we use your comment as a testimonial?
example_zh: 我們可以把您的評語當作客戶推薦語嗎？

example_en: We published a case study about their network upgrade.
example_zh: 我們發表了一篇他們網路升級的客戶案例。

example_en: Customers say the new app is very user-friendly.
example_zh: 客戶說新的 App 很容易上手。

example_en: Our goal is to exceed customer expectations.
example_zh: 我們的目標是超出客戶的預期。

example_en: Our support team always goes the extra mile.
example_zh: 我們的客服團隊總是格外用心。

example_en: The client praised us for being so responsive.
example_zh: 客戶稱讚我們回應得非常迅速。

example_en: The staff were attentive and polite.
example_zh: 工作人員細心周到又有禮貌。

example_en: Always stay courteous, even with difficult callers.
example_zh: 即使遇到難搞的來電者，也要保持禮貌。

example_en: The client was impressed by our team's professionalism.
example_zh: 客戶對我們團隊的專業態度印象深刻。

example_en: I have two sales calls in Hsinchu tomorrow.
example_zh: 我明天在新竹有兩場業務拜訪。

example_en: I made twenty cold calls this morning.
example_zh: 我今天早上打了二十通陌生開發電話。

zh: 向上銷售；推銷更高階方案
example_en: We can upsell the premium plan to heavy data users.
example_zh: 我們可以向重度上網用戶推銷高階方案。

zh: 交叉銷售；搭售相關產品
example_en: Try to cross-sell home internet to mobile customers.
example_zh: 試著把家用寬頻推銷給行動用戶。

zh: 價值主張；能為客戶帶來的好處
example_en: Our value proposition is reliable service at a fair price.
example_zh: 我們的價值主張是以合理價格提供穩定服務。

example_en: We can offer a competitive price for a two-year term.
example_zh: 簽兩年的話，我們可以提供有競爭力的價格。

example_en: The bundle includes mobile, internet and TV.
example_zh: 這個組合方案包含行動、網路和電視。

example_en: This special offer is only for existing members.
example_zh: 這個優惠方案只限既有會員。

example_en: This is a limited-time offer that ends Friday.
example_zh: 這是限時優惠，週五截止。

example_en: Price negotiation will start after the demo.
example_zh: 產品展示之後就會開始議價。

example_en: Can we meet halfway on the price?
example_zh: 價格方面我們能各退一步嗎？

example_en: We want a win-win deal for both companies.
example_zh: 我們希望達成對雙方公司都雙贏的交易。

example_en: We hope to close the deal before year-end.
example_zh: 我們希望在年底前成交。

example_en: Slow support is a deal breaker for this client.
example_zh: 客服反應慢，對這位客戶來說是會讓交易破局的因素。

example_en: Small businesses are usually very price-sensitive.
example_zh: 小型企業通常對價格非常敏感。

example_en: The client is still hesitant about switching providers.
example_zh: 客戶對於更換供應商還在猶豫。

example_en: Due to budget constraints, they chose the basic plan.
example_zh: 因為預算限制，他們選了基本方案。

example_en: Reviews have a big impact on purchase decisions.
example_zh: 評價對購買決策影響很大。

example_en: We need buy-in from their IT department first.
example_zh: 我們需要先取得他們資訊部門的認同。

example_en: We'd love to meet in person when you visit Taipei.
example_zh: 您來台北時，我們很希望能當面見個面。

example_en: Our president will make a courtesy visit in December.
example_zh: 我們社長十二月會來做禮貌性拜訪。

example_en: We often entertain clients after the annual meeting.
example_zh: 年度會議結束後，我們常會招待客戶。

example_en: Please accept this gift as a token of our appreciation.
example_zh: 請收下這份禮物，聊表我們的謝意。

example_en: We hold a customer appreciation event every spring.
example_zh: 我們每年春天都會舉辦客戶答謝活動。

example_en: The client placed an order for 50 new phones.
example_zh: 客戶下單訂購 50 支新手機。

example_en: You'll receive an order confirmation by email.
example_zh: 您會收到一封訂單確認信。

example_en: Your item is on backorder and will ship next month.
example_zh: 您的商品目前缺貨待補，下個月出貨。

example_en: Sorry, the white model is out of stock.
example_zh: 抱歉，白色款目前缺貨。

example_en: The estimated delivery date is October 15.
example_zh: 預計到貨日是 10 月 15 日。

example_en: Here is your tracking number for the shipment.
example_zh: 這是您這批貨的追蹤號碼。

example_en: We'll upgrade your order to priority shipping.
example_zh: 我們會把您的訂單改為優先出貨。

example_en: Rush orders need approval from the factory.
example_zh: 急件訂單需要工廠核准。

example_en: May I have your account number, please?
example_zh: 請問您的客戶編號是多少？

example_en: For security, we need to complete identity verification first.
example_zh: 為了安全起見，我們需要先完成身分驗證。

example_en: We never share your personal information with third parties.
example_zh: 我們絕不會將您的個資提供給第三方。

example_en: Call recordings are used for training and quality checks.
example_zh: 通話錄音會用於教育訓練和品質檢查。

example_en: Please update your contact details on the website.
example_zh: 請到網站上更新您的聯絡資料。

example_en: You can change your marketing preferences in the app.
example_zh: 您可以在 App 裡更改行銷訊息的偏好設定。

example_en: Join our loyalty program to earn points.
example_zh: 加入我們的會員回饋計畫就能累積點數。

example_en: You can use reward points to pay for accessories.
example_zh: 您可以用紅利點數折抵配件費用。

example_en: Your membership will be renewed automatically.
example_zh: 您的會籍會自動續約。

example_en: Be honest about delays to manage expectations.
example_zh: 延誤時要誠實告知，才能管理好客戶的期望。

example_en: Thanks for letting me know. I'll get right on it.
example_zh: 謝謝您告訴我，我馬上處理。

example_en: Don't worry, I'll take care of it today.
example_zh: 別擔心，這件事我今天就會處理好。

zh: 請稍等我一下；請多包涵
example_en: Please bear with me while I check your account.
example_zh: 我查一下您的帳戶，請稍候。

example_en: Let me pull up your order history.
example_zh: 我幫您調出訂單紀錄。

example_en: Unfortunately, we are unable to change the due date.
example_zh: 很遺憾，我們無法更改繳費期限。

example_en: With all due respect, the delay was not caused by us.
example_zh: 恕我直言，這次延誤並不是我們造成的。

en: You have every right to be upset.
zh: 您會不高興是完全合理的。
ipa: /ju ˈhæv ˈɛvri ˈraɪt tə bi ʌpˈsɛt/
example_en: You have every right to be upset. Let me fix this now.
example_zh: 您會不高興是完全合理的，我現在就處理。

en: I see where you're coming from.
example_en: I see where you're coming from, but the rules are fixed.
example_zh: 我明白您的出發點，但規定沒辦法改。

example_en: I want to reassure you that your data is safe.
example_zh: 請您放心，您的資料是安全的。

example_en: We had to turn down their request for a free upgrade.
example_zh: 我們只好拒絕他們免費升級的要求。

example_en: Be tactful when you explain the price increase.
example_zh: 說明漲價的時候，措辭要得體。

example_en: Stay firm but polite when the customer pushes back.
example_zh: 客戶反彈時，態度要堅定但有禮。

zh: 那超出我們能掌控的範圍。
example_en: The typhoon delay is, unfortunately, beyond our control.
example_zh: 很遺憾，颱風造成的延誤超出我們能掌控的範圍。

example_en: We are handling your case as a matter of priority.
example_zh: 我們正在優先處理您的案件。

example_en: I'll make sure the technician arrives on time.
example_zh: 我會確保技術人員準時到達。

example_en: We'll give you advance notice before any price change.
example_zh: 任何價格調整前，我們都會事先通知您。

example_en: We make a courtesy call one month after installation.
example_zh: 安裝一個月後，我們會打一通關懷電話。

example_en: I have a quick check-in call with the client today.
example_zh: 我今天要和客戶簡短通個電話了解近況。

example_en: Customer onboarding usually takes two weeks.
example_zh: 新客戶導入通常需要兩週。

example_en: We hold an account review with them every six months.
example_zh: 我們每半年和他們做一次合作檢討。

example_en: The client wants to discuss pricing at the quarterly business review.
example_zh: 客戶想在季度業務檢討會上討論價格。

example_en: Cultural differences can affect how clients give feedback.
example_zh: 文化差異會影響客戶給意見的方式。

example_en: A quick reply makes a good first impression.
example_zh: 快速回覆能留下好的第一印象。

example_en: Keep a calm tone of voice on the phone.
example_zh: 講電話時要保持冷靜的語氣。

example_en: Active listening helps you find the real problem.
example_zh: 積極聆聽能幫你找出真正的問題。

zh: 換句話說；用自己的話轉述
example_en: Paraphrase the request to confirm you understood it.
example_zh: 用自己的話把需求轉述一次，確認自己理解正確。

example_en: Sorry about the mix-up with your shipping address.
example_zh: 抱歉把您的寄送地址弄錯了。

example_en: The wrong delivery was caused by miscommunication.
example_zh: 送錯貨是溝通落差造成的。

example_en: Let's clear up the confusion about the contract dates.
example_zh: 我們來澄清一下合約日期的混淆。

example_en: May I politely remind you that payment is due Friday?
example_zh: 容我委婉提醒，付款期限是週五。

example_en: We value your business and want to keep you happy.
example_zh: 我們很珍惜與您的合作，希望您一直滿意。
